title: Implement Binary Search Algorithm
description: You are given a skeleton JavaScript file with a binary search function that needs to be implemented. The function should search for a target value in a sorted array and return its index, or -1 if not found.

features.name: Binary Search Implementation
features.description: Implement the binary search algorithm that efficiently searches for a target value in a sorted array using the divide-and-conquer approach.
testCases: Should return correct index when target is found
Should return -1 when target is not found
Should handle arrays with single element
Should handle target at beginning of array
Should handle target at end of array
Should have O(log n) time complexity

features.name: Edge Case Handling
features.description: Implement proper handling of edge cases such as empty arrays, single element arrays, and values outside the array range.
testCases: Should handle arrays with one element
Should handle target less than minimum value
Should handle target greater than maximum value
